items.text: Reads a field drug-test kit with the phone camera, gives a result, and saves a sealed record.
Start a test (needs the printed card)
Prototype for Smart India Hackathon 2026, SIH26231. Presumptive result only.
Do the kit test as usual. The app works alongside the colour-change kits officers already use.
Put the test on the printed reference colour card and take a photo in the app. The test goes in the white square; the card must be fully in view.
The card’s known colours let the app correct for the lighting. Daylight, a tube light or a shadow change how colours look; the card’s colour squares show by how much.

The app compares the test colour with the kit’s reference colours: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE or INCONCLUSIVE. If the photo is not good enough (blur, shadow, glare, card too far, a corner hidden), it says Retake and why. This is detected automatically.
Saving makes a sealed record in the log. It holds the time, the place, the officer and the photo’s fingerprint. Any later change to it is caught.
It gives a presumptive field result. It never replaces laboratory confirmation.
Marquis reagent — opiate screen: colours from NIJ Standard-0604.01 (a US Department of Justice standard), not yet checked on a real reaction.

A printed card with 30 known colours, four black corner squares the app finds automatically, and a white square for the test. Print it in colour on A4 at 100% and check the 50 mm bar with a ruler. About this app and how it works
For the team: saves test photos to improve the app. No results, no records.
While it is on, capture works even when checks fail (so deliberately bad photos can be collected), each photo is tagged and saved on this phone, and the Captures tab appears.
Rear camera, 1920×1080 requested. What the phone delivers is recorded with every photo.
Provisional = a reasoned starting value, not yet checked against enough real photos. Derived = computed from named real photos.
Blur check — minimum sharpness blurMinLaplacianVariance = 680 (variance of the 4-neighbour Laplacian of 8-bit luma at check scale, on the detected card (framing outline if no card)) · derived
Overexposure — brightness counted as blown out highlightClipLevel = 254 (8-bit channel value at or above which a channel counts as clipped) · provisional
Overexposure — share of the frame allowed to be blown out maxHighlightClipFraction = 0.02 (fraction of pixels inside the framing outline blown to white (all three channels clipped)) · provisional
Underexposure — darkness counted as pure black shadowClipLevel = 3 (8-bit value at or below which a pixel (max channel) counts as crushed black) · provisional
Underexposure — share of the frame allowed to be pure black maxShadowClipFraction = 0.1 (fraction of pixels inside the framing outline with max channel crushed) · provisional
Too dark — minimum overall brightness minMedianLuma = 50 (median 8-bit Rec. 601 luma inside the framing outline) · provisional
Card ID — how clearly each ID square must read idCellMargin = 0.15 (fraction of the (white - black) luma range either side of the midpoint where an ID cell counts as unreadable) · provisional
Card too far — minimum camera pixels per colour square minPatchSourcePixels = 400 (camera pixels inside each patch's central 5 x 5 mm sampling square (minimum over all patches)) · provisional

Glare on the card — share of a colour square allowed to be blown out maxClipFraction = 0.02 (fraction of pixels in any patch sampling square, or in the sample zone, with any channel at or above highlightClipLevel) · provisional

Uneven light — most unevenness left after the light correction maxResidualWhiteRatio = 1.2 (brightest / dimmest linear luminance of the six white patches (W_T, W_B, W_L, W_R1, W_R2, N1) AFTER the fitted smooth light gradient is divided out) · provisional
Correction quality — largest average error on the card maxLooMeanDeltaE00 = 5 (mean leave-one-out CIEDE2000 over the card patches after correction) · provisional
Correction quality — largest error on the worst tenth of the card maxLooP90DeltaE00 = 10 (90th percentile leave-one-out CIEDE2000 over the card patches after correction) · provisional

Card set-up — most disagreement allowed between set-up photos maxRegistrationSpreadDeltaE00 = 6 (largest CIEDE2000 between any two registration shots, for any patch, after flat-field and per-shot white normalisation) · provisional

Test area — how far from white paper counts as colour sampleWhiteNoiseFactor = 3 (multiple of the white-paper noise (95th percentile of per-pixel ΔE76 from paper white over the six white patches, after flat-field) above which a sample-zone pixel counts as coloured) · provisional
Test area — smallest colour difference ever counted sampleMinDeltaE = 3 (ΔE76 floor for the coloured-pixel threshold) · provisional
Test area — edge trimmed off before reading sampleEdgeErodeMm = 0.5 (mm trimmed off the edge of the coloured region (square erosion) before sampling) · provisional
Test area — specks smaller than this are ignored sampleNoiseFloorMm2 = 2 (mm² (after erosion): a largest coloured region smaller than this counts as no coloured region) · provisional
Test area — smallest test that can be read sampleMinAreaMm2 = 10 (mm² (after erosion) the coloured region must cover to be read ("Coloured area too small" below it)) · provisional

Test area — a second patch this big means two tests sampleSecondRegionMm2 = 10 (mm² (after erosion): a second separate coloured region at least this big means two tests ("Two separate coloured areas")) · provisional

Glare on the test — share of the test allowed to be blown out maxSampleClipFraction = 0.02 (fraction of the coloured region (holes filled) with any channel at or above highlightClipLevel) · provisional
Test area — pixels too dark to use sampleDarkLevel = 10 (8-bit max channel at or below which a sample pixel is dropped as too dark to carry colour) · provisional

Patchy test — most colour variation allowed maxSampleSpreadDeltaE = 15 (90th percentile ΔE76 of the sampled pixels from their median colour (flat-fielded, white-normalised, before correction)) · provisional

About this app and how it works
For the team: saves test photos to improve the app. No results, no records.
While it is on, capture works even when checks fail (so deliberately bad photos can be collected), each photo is tagged and saved on this phone, and the Captures tab appears.
Rear camera, 1920×1080 requested. What the phone delivers is recorded with every photo.
Provisional = a reasoned starting value, not yet checked against enough real photos. Derived = computed from named real photos.
Blur check — minimum sharpness blurMinLaplacianVariance = 680 (variance of the 4-neighbour Laplacian of 8-bit luma at check scale, on the detected card (framing outline if no card)) · derived
Overexposure — brightness counted as blown out highlightClipLevel = 254 (8-bit channel value at or above which a channel counts as clipped) · provisional
Overexposure — share of the frame allowed to be blown out maxHighlightClipFraction = 0.02 (fraction of pixels inside the framing outline blown to white (all three channels clipped)) · provisional
Underexposure — darkness counted as pure black shadowClipLevel = 3 (8-bit value at or below which a pixel (max channel) counts as crushed black) · provisional
Underexposure — share of the frame allowed to be pure black maxShadowClipFraction = 0.1 (fraction of pixels inside the framing outline with max channel crushed) · provisional
Too dark — minimum overall brightness minMedianLuma = 50 (median 8-bit Rec. 601 luma inside the framing outline) · provisional
Card ID — how clearly each ID square must read idCellMargin = 0.15 (fraction of the (white - black) luma range either side of the midpoint where an ID cell counts as unreadable) · provisional
Card too far — minimum camera pixels per colour square minPatchSourcePixels = 400 (camera pixels inside each patch's central 5 x 5 mm sampling square (minimum over all patches)) · provisional

Glare on the card — share of a colour square allowed to be blown out maxClipFraction = 0.02 (fraction of pixels in any patch sampling square, or in the sample zone, with any channel at or above highlightClipLevel) · provisional

Uneven light — most unevenness left after the light correction maxResidualWhiteRatio = 1.2 (brightest / dimmest linear luminance of the six white patches (W_T, W_B, W_L, W_R1, W_R2, N1) AFTER the fitted smooth light gradient is divided out) · provisional
Correction quality — largest average error on the card maxLooMeanDeltaE00 = 5 (mean leave-one-out CIEDE2000 over the card patches after correction) · provisional
Correction quality — largest error on the worst tenth of the card maxLooP90DeltaE00 = 10 (90th percentile leave-one-out CIEDE2000 over the card patches after correction) · provisional

Card set-up — most disagreement allowed between set-up photos maxRegistrationSpreadDeltaE00 = 6 (largest CIEDE2000 between any two registration shots, for any patch, after flat-field and per-shot white normalisation) · provisional

Test area — how far from white paper counts as colour sampleWhiteNoiseFactor = 3 (multiple of the white-paper noise (95th percentile of per-pixel ΔE76 from paper white over the six white patches, after flat-field) above which a sample-zone pixel counts as coloured) · provisional
Test area — smallest colour difference ever counted sampleMinDeltaE = 3 (ΔE76 floor for the coloured-pixel threshold) · provisional
Test area — edge trimmed off before reading sampleEdgeErodeMm = 0.5 (mm trimmed off the edge of the coloured region (square erosion) before sampling) · provisional
Test area — specks smaller than this are ignored sampleNoiseFloorMm2 = 2 (mm² (after erosion): a largest coloured region smaller than this counts as no coloured region) · provisional
Test area — smallest test that can be read sampleMinAreaMm2 = 10 (mm² (after erosion) the coloured region must cover to be read ("Coloured area too small" below it)) · provisional

Test area — a second patch this big means two tests sampleSecondRegionMm2 = 10 (mm² (after erosion): a second separate coloured region at least this big means two tests ("Two separate coloured areas")) · provisional

Glare on the test — share of the test allowed to be blown out maxSampleClipFraction = 0.02 (fraction of the coloured region (holes filled) with any channel at or above highlightClipLevel) · provisional
Test area — pixels too dark to use sampleDarkLevel = 10 (8-bit max channel at or below which a sample pixel is dropped as too dark to carry colour) · provisional

Patchy test — most colour variation allowed maxSampleSpreadDeltaE = 15 (90th percentile ΔE76 of the sampled pixels from their median colour (flat-fielded, white-normalised, before correction)) · provisional
